messages:
Marta: FYI PR #16666 caused a CI microbench failure on the kernel-selection path — batch latency up ~12% vs baseline. bench-bot posted details below.
bench-bot: CI microbench FAILED for 'batch_kernel_choice_latency' (baseline=12.3ms, current=13.8ms, delta=+12.2%). Full log: https://ci.internal/reports/5987654321
Alex: quick glance — kernel selector chose matmul_v2 instead of fast_matmul for seqlen=128 in the CI config. That explains the latency jump.
Ryan: can you paste the flamegraph snippet or hotspot from the run?
Marta: flamegraph shows hotspot at kernel_selector.cpp:142 -> matmul_v2. Also saw a short KV cache hit-rate dip during warmup logs (first 50ms).
Jamie: KV trace: hit-rate fell from 98% -> 85% during the warmup window. Might be eviction thrash from recent allocator tweak.
Alex: that matches my hunch — allocator change in commit 9f3a2b7 changed slab boundaries which nudged small-allocation behavior; kernel cost model then preferred matmul_v2. Bisecting now.
bench-bot: Starting bisect job (range: 9f3a2b7..HEAD) running microbench harness (10 runs per candidate). Will report top candidates.
Marta: plan: if bisect points to 9f3a2b7 revert that commit immediately. If it's a downstream interaction, revert the offending follow-up. Also consider temporarily pinning kernel-selector to legacy weights for the rollout gate.
Ryan: +1. Tag me when you open the revert PR. If we revert, let's run a dedicated shadow run against production traffic shape before unblocking the rollout.
Jamie: reproducible command for the bisect runs: ```./tools/run_microbench --bench=batch_kernel_choice_latency --runs=10 --env=ci-shadow --seqlen=128```
Alex: bisect result: culprit narrowed to commit 3/7 in the range — commit hash d4c7e1b (allocator tweak). Opening revert PR now (ref #16680).
Marta: thanks. Merging revert once CI on the revert is green, then re-run the microbench baseline. If that fixes, we'll follow up with a proper fix — adjust kernel cost weights + add a test for allocator changes.
bench-bot: CI for revert PR #16680 queued.
Alex: note for postmortem: add a microbench that asserts kernel selection for common seqlen buckets stays stable across allocator parameter changes. Also add KV warmup guard to detect transient hit-rate drops in CI.
Marta: Agreed — I'll draft the postmortem and the test plan. Will create a small checklist for release engineers to run the shadow microbench before rollouts. :memo:
Ryan: solid. Thanks everyone for the quick triage. :thumbsup:
